legislature_chamber.no_open_vacancies_ev: No open vacancies — every seat is either serving or filled.

legislature_chamber.term_one_clock_for_e: Term — one clock for every elected office

legislature_chamber.the_chamber_is_circu: The chamber is circular — there is no head of the room; the Speaker presides from among equals and votes only to break ties (Art. II §3). Seat-map seniority and the roster's normalized vote share are display of certified records.
legislature_chamber.the_chamber_itself_w: The chamber itself: who serves, who presides, what the peg thresholds are, and what a freshly constituted legislature must do first. Every threshold here is the engine's arithmetic over ALL serving seats — never over those present.
legislature_chamber.this_legislature_has: This legislature has no seated members yet. The seat map appears when the first general election certifies; the first-sessions checklist below is the constituting to-do list.
legislature_chamber.type_a_across_the_di: {seats} type A across the districts + {seats2} type B, one per constituent — both kinds must independently agree · Art. V §3.

legislature_committeedetail.committee_ag: Committee agendas have no engine-locked head — emergency review is a floor-session duty (Art. II §2).

legislature_committeedetail.entered_verb: Entered verbatim into the public record — testimony cannot be edited or withdrawn.
legislature_committeedetail.hearings_tak: Hearings take testimony from any resident; entries publish verbatim to the immutable public record · WF-LEG-08 · WF-SYS-03.
legislature_committeedetail.meetings_are: Meetings are called by the chair — or the alternate when the chair is absent (F-CHR-001 · R-12/R-13).
legislature_committeedetail.moves_the_bi: Moves the bill to the floor and opens its floor vote
legislature_committeedetail.no_agenda_ye: No agenda yet — the chair sets it (F-CHR-002).
legislature_committeedetail.no_bills_ref: No bills referred to this committee.
legislature_committeedetail.not_yet_seat: Not yet seated — placements arrive with the F-SPK-005 assignment run on the committees page.
legislature_committeedetail.reports_are_: Reports are filed by the chair — or the alternate when the chair is absent (F-CHR-004 · R-12/R-13). The report body publishes to the public record.
legislature_committeedetail.testimony_at: Testimony attaches to a meeting — none is scheduled.
legislature_committeedetail.the_committe: The committee decides by majority of all its members; a passed vote flips the bill to reported, which is the only state from which the chair's F-CHR-003 referral can move it to the floor. The engine enforces the gate server-side — the disabled button is honesty, not the boundary.
The committee vote opens with the referral motion's adoption (WF-LEG-06) — majority of ALL committee members, not those present · Art. II §4.
legislature_committeedetail.your_cast_is: Your cast is recorded — casts are immutable.
legislature_committees.bicameral_committ: Bicameral committees mirror the chamber-kind ratio — largest remainder over serving type A : type B, each kind ≥ 1 at 2+ seats · Art. V §3.
legislature_committees.committee_assignm: Committee assignment is faction-independent: every member rank-orders every committee; placements honor rank order; ties break to the seat holder with the largest vote share after normalizing quotas. This preserves the proportional representation the STV election produced while making assignment independent of any party layer.
legislature_committees.committee_seat_s_: {total_seats} committee seat(s) across {committee_count} committee(s) · {total_reps} serving member(s) · Art. II §4 · as implemented
legislature_committees.committee_seats_a: Committee seats are assigned from each member's own ranked preferences — every member answers for themselves, with no party machinery in between. When two members want the same last seat, it goes to whoever won the larger share of the vote at the election.
legislature_committees.contested_committ: Contested committee seats resolved by normalized vote share
legislature_committees.enabled_when_all_: enabled when all serving members have submitted — the Speaker may also run with defaults applied (engine-validated)
legislature_committees.locked_an_f_spk_0: Locked — an F-SPK-005 run snapshots all inputs; later edits affect only future runs.
legislature_committees.no_committees_yet: No committees yet — any member may file the creation act above; the committee exists only when the supermajority adopts it.
legislature_committees.no_contested_seat: No contested seats — every placement honored a preference without a tie-break.
legislature_committees.not_yet_seated_ru: not yet seated — run the assignment
legislature_committees.of_serving_member: {submitted} of {serving} serving members have submitted preferences. Non-submitters default to committee creation order.
legislature_committees.placements_distri: Placements distribute evenly across members — counts differ by at most one. Multi-org-endorsed and endorsement-less members are first-class: there is no faction layer anywhere in the procedure · ledger #q1.
legislature_committees.rank_every_commit: Rank every committee — the assignment algorithm honors your order; ties break by normalized vote share (ledger #q2). Default order is committee creation order. Keyboard: ↑/↓ buttons or Alt+Arrow keys — no drag needed.
legislature_committees.rank_the_committe: Rank the committee's seated members for chair — all serving members cast, Speaker included (constitutive election · Art. II §3 · as implemented).
legislature_committees.re_check_pending_: {note} re-check pending the chamber countback · WF-LEG-13
legislature_committees.the_assignment_ru: The assignment run is the Speaker's administration (F-SPK-005 · R-10).
legislature_committees.the_committee_exi: The committee exists only when the supermajority vote adopts (Art. II §4).
legislature_committees.the_winner_is_the: The winner is the largest vote share after normalizing quotas to account for one-person-one-vote deviations; the loser's next preference is honored in the same pass · Art. II §4 · as implemented (ledger #q2).
legislature_committees.tie_broken_is_the: tie_broken is the F-SPK-005 normalized-quota branch (ledger #q2); vacated seats refill by whole-house RCV among members at the chamber-minimum placement count (WF-LEG-13 — proportion-safe with no faction layer).
legislature_committees.type_a_type_b_mir: — {type_a} type A + {type_b} type B mirrors the chamber-kind ratio · Art. V §3
legislature_committees.whole_legislature: whole-legislature RCV · candidates = the committee's seated members
legislature_committees.your_cast_is_reco: Your cast is recorded — casts are immutable (the record is the record).
legislature_committees.your_chair_ballot: Your chair ballot is recorded — rankings are public · Art. II §2.

legislature_districts.contiguity_is_cons: Contiguity is considered broken only when it was achievable in the first place. Geographic impossibilities are exempt. These include island jurisdictions with no land border to any sibling, members completely surrounded by jurisdictions too large to combine without breaching the constitutional ceiling, and single-member districts, which are never constitutionally incongruous. The same applies to similarly isolated clusters that cannot reach the constitutional floor.

In all other cases, sub-districts can be created along existing administrative borders.

legislature_emergencypowers.all_validati: All validation runs PRE-VOTE: the closed cause enum, the ≤ 90-day ceiling, the area-of-authority check, and the methods requirement reject before any vote is taken — the rejection rows are the operator-visible record. The power row and its CLK-03 countdown exist only on supermajority adoption.
legislature_emergencypowers.auto_expiry_: Auto-expiry at the declared duration — no action required, no extension without a fresh supermajority.
Auto-expiry publishes a full audit record — nothing rolls over silently.
legislature_emergencypowers.available_at: available at any time, by any inhabitant · filing arrives with the judiciary (Planned · Phase E) · Art. II §7 · WF-JUD-06
legislature_emergencypowers.cannot_disru: cannot disrupt elections, sessions, courts, or any civic process — enforced in code · Art. II §7
legislature_emergencypowers.cause_the_on: Cause — the only two the engine accepts
legislature_emergencypowers.civic_proces: Civic-process protection: elections, sessions, courts, and every civic process cannot be disrupted — enforced in code.
legislature_emergencypowers.clk_03_the_9: CLK-03 — the 90-day ceiling is itself the amendable setting's constitutional maximum
legislature_emergencypowers.e_g_evacuati: e.g. evacuation orders, shelter requisition, debris-clearance contracting
legislature_emergencypowers.emergency_po: Emergency powers exist for exactly two causes — natural disaster and actual invasion. They require a supermajority, run at most 90 days, are judicially reviewable at any time, auto-expire, and can never disrupt elections, sessions, or courts. Any active power is the first order of business at every session.
legislature_emergencypowers.engine_valid: Engine validation: area ≤ this legislature's authority — own or descendant jurisdictions only.
Engine validation: methods must remain within constitutional order — rights and civic processes are untouchable.
legislature_emergencypowers.first_order_: First order of business: an active power leads the agenda of every session until it ends (AgendaStrip slot 1 — session console).
legislature_emergencypowers.hard_ceiling: hard ceiling: 90 days · CLK-03 · Art. II §7
legislature_emergencypowers.invocation_i: Invocation is filed by a serving member (F-LEG-024, R-09) and adopted only by supermajority of all serving. Every declaration, renewal, and expiry publishes to the public record — citizens read this dashboard at all times.
legislature_emergencypowers.no_other_cau: No other cause exists. Economic, political, or public-order rationales are rejected pre-vote.
legislature_emergencypowers.requires_sup: requires supermajority of all serving — {supermajority} of {serving} · Art. II §7

legislature_index.no_legislatures_yet_co: No legislatures yet — complete setup (apportionment) to found the first one.

legislature_index.wf_jur_01_jurisdiction: WF-JUR-01 — jurisdictions bootstrap from dormant boundary to self-governing. Each activation seats a cube-root-sized legislature (bicameral where constituent jurisdictions exist, Art. V §3) plus executive and judiciary stubs.
legislature_oversight.catalog_alias_f_le: catalog alias: F-LEG-030 · workflows catalog (renumbering drift). Declarer rule (hardened): the Speaker or system may declare any current seat; a plain member only their own — declaration is never a weapon · Art. II §5.
legislature_oversight.creation_act_vote_: Creation act vote — majority of all serving
legislature_oversight.from_any_resident_: From any resident, any member, or the chamber's own motion. No catalog form exists for intake (flagged registry gap) — the complaint is an audited non-form action; the docket is public.
legislature_oversight.intake_requires_a_: Intake requires a live administrative office (F-LEG-013) and an authenticated account.
legislature_oversight.needs_the_supermaj: Needs the supermajority of ALL serving — vacancies stay in the denominator; the Speaker presides and cannot cast (a supermajority tie is arithmetically impossible).
legislature_oversight.no_administrative_: No administrative office exists — intake cannot docket until the chamber creates one by majority act.
legislature_oversight.nominees_follow_th: Nominees follow the appointment-consent pipeline — one majority consent vote each; 10-year civil appointments (CLK-09).
legislature_oversight.removal_parity_leg: Removal parity: legislators, executives, and judges are removed by the same standard — a supermajority of all serving members. The Speaker presides, never over their own case (Art. II §3 · removal.presider, hardened).
legislature_oversight.staff_nominee_user: Staff nominee user IDs (one per line, optional)
legislature_oversight.supermajority_of_a: supermajority of all serving · Art. VII
legislature_oversight.the_independent_ad: The independent administrative office enforces parliamentary procedure and the ethics code. It takes misconduct complaints, investigates, and refers findings to removal proceedings — and it declares vacancies when seats fall empty.

population-supermajority acts shielded from same-term modification · CLK-19

legislature_referendums.queued_for_the_n: Queued for the next jurisdiction-wide ballot
legislature_referendums.requires_superma: requires supermajority of all serving — {supermajority} of {serving} · Art. II §6
legislature_referendums.resolved_questio: Resolved questions — results at the matching threshold
legislature_referendums.the_binding_text: The binding text the referendum enacts — not a summary.
legislature_referendums.the_clk_19_shiel: The CLK-19 shield is a validator gate, not a timer: an F-LEG-034 filing against a population-supermajority act is rejected pre-vote with the citation, and the rejection itself lands on the audit chain. The shield releases when the next general election certifies — referendum acts then amend through the ordinary path.
legislature_referendums.the_legislature_: The legislature can put any issue to the population by supermajority. The passage threshold is not chosen — it matches the kind of act: a question the legislature could pass by simple majority resolves by a majority of the population; one that would need a supermajority resolves by a population supermajority.
legislature_referendums.this_term_chambe: this term: chamber supermajority · F-LEG-034 · WF-LEG-19
legislature_sessionconsole.adjournment_i: Adjournment is the Speaker's (or admin staff's) filing — F-SPK-009.

legislature_sessionconsole.balloting_ope: balloting open — {cast_count} of {serving} serving have cast · closes at full participation

legislature_sessionconsole.sessions_are_: Sessions are called by the chamber's Speaker (or the system under CLK-02).

legislature_sessionconsole.speaker_elect: Speaker election — the first order of the first session
legislature_sessionconsole.the_deciding_: The deciding vote opens in the same filing — ordinary majority of all serving.
legislature_sessionconsole.the_session_m: The session machine: scheduled → open → adjourned, with the failed-quorum branch (WF-LEG-20). Quorum counts precede everything; it is the call itself, not an agenda item.
legislature_sessionconsole.the_speaker_p: The Speaker presides and does not move or vote on business — only the tie-breaking vote (F-SPK-004) · Art. II §3.
legislature_sessionconsole.until_the_cha: Until the chamber elects its Speaker there is no R-10: sessions cannot be humanly called and general business cannot open. legislature_sessionconsole.winner_seated: winner: {winner} — seated as Speaker · public record kind certification

legislature_settings.must_stay_in_lockst: must stay in lockstep · CLK-09 / CLK-10
legislature_settings.no_setting_has_been: No setting has been amended in this jurisdiction — every value is a founding (or inherited) default.
legislature_settings.pick_propose_change: Pick "Propose change" on any row above to pre-target a bill at that setting.
legislature_settings.supermajority_can_n: supermajority can never fall below majority + 1 · Art. VII
legislature_settings.the_constitutional_: {message} The Constitutional Engine blocks the bill before any vote is taken — no UI, admin panel, or legislative act can carry an out-of-range value; an actual filing of this value would land as a rejected=true audit-chain entry.
legislature_settings.the_hardened_floor_: The hardened floor — what no act can change
legislature_settings.these_are_the_rules: These are the rules this legislature can change by passing a law (its "constitutional settings") — each one inside limits that no law can override. Out-of-range proposals are rejected before any vote is taken.
legislature_settings.voting_method_only_: voting_method — only a MORE proportional method, never FPTP or plurality · Art. II §2
legislature_show.no_members_yet_seats_fi: No members yet — seats fill when a general election is certified (Art. II §1). The chamber constitutes itself at its first sessions.
legislature_show.one_legislature_sized_b: One legislature, sized by its people. Every jurisdiction can seat its own chamber (CLK-06) — this page is that chamber's front door: its seats, its term, who serves, and the district maps that shape it.
legislature_show.speaker: Speaker: {speaker_name}
legislature_show.the_district_mapper_whe: The district mapper — where this legislature's seats meet the map: versioned district plans, the autoseeder, quality metrics, and the manual drawing tools.
legislature_speakertools.facilitation_ta: Facilitation targets an upcoming session — none is scheduled; call one on the session console (F-SPK-001).
legislature_speakertools.members_hand_th: Members hand the Speaker their priorities; facilitation appends each to the next session's unlocked agenda tail. The filing itself is the priorities log — slots 1–2 (emergency powers, constitutional matters) stay locked (Art. II §2).
legislature_speakertools.no_tie_has_need: No tie has needed breaking this term.
legislature_speakertools.politically_neu: politically neutral · votes only to break ties · Art. II §3
legislature_speakertools.the_only_speake: The only Speaker votes on record — each cast via F-SPK-004 on a vote that closed tied, recomputed against the unchanged peg threshold.
legislature_speakertools.the_speaker_fac: The Speaker facilitates and stays politically neutral: they remain a serving member in every denominator, vote only to break ties, and preside over removal proceedings — never their own. This page is the launchpad for the nine Speaker forms; each control lives on its working surface.
legislature_speakertools.the_speaker_pre: The Speaker presides over every removal proceeding except their own case, where the chamber designates a substitute.
legislature_speakertools.the_speaker_sta: The Speaker stays in every quorum and threshold denominator. On yes/no business a Speaker cast is rejected pre-commit unless the vote stands tied — and a tie-break never manufactures a supermajority (Art. VII).
legislature_speakertools.this_page_never: This page never duplicates a console: F-SPK-001/002/003/008/009 run on the session console, F-SPK-005 on the committees page, F-SPK-007 on oversight. The tie-break record and priorities queue live here because they are records of the office itself.
legislature_speakertools.you_are_the_sub: You are the subject — the engine blocks you from presiding; the chamber designates a substitute · Art. II §3 (removal.presider, hardened).
legislature_speakertools.you_hold_a_seat: You hold a seat in this chamber (R-09) but are not its Speaker — this is the "what the Speaker can do" view. Actions are hidden here, and the engine rejects them regardless (the role gate is the handler's, never the page's).
